_what_this_is: Alternative mandates for the same grant. Each scenario is a deployer's sentence and the primitives it wants and refuses; everything else is unstated. The grant never changes; the delta is recomputed per scenario. Written on this site as starting points to be argued with.

scenarios.label: Answer from my drive
scenarios.description: Read my connected drive and my uploads; nothing goes out.

scenarios.label: Summarise my mail
scenarios.description: Read my mail through the connector and summarise it.

scenarios.label: Just chat
scenarios.description: Conversation and uploads only, connectors untouched.

scenarios.label: Push code from chat
scenarios.description: Write to the code host through the connector.

scenarios.label: Act in my accounts
scenarios.description: Use every connector as me: drive, mail, code host.

scenarios.label: Reply to mail for me
scenarios.description: Read my mail and send replies.
